decisions.reason: The terminology change directly applies because the source introduces these as buttons in the shell and states that the shell will be called Console from now on.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Thank you for this. I’ll gather some opinions and feedback. I also wanted your thoughts about the color, shape, and size of the buttons in the shell, which I’ll refer to as Console from now on. They haven’t been styled yet, so they currently use the default: fairly large, rounded-corner buttons in a blue shade. Should we choose a color, or would monochrome be better? I’m also considering adding an icon to every button to make them more interesting.
